name: Infernal Pact
description: Planar Pact Feat (Prerequisite: Can’t Have Another Planar Pact Feat) You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Infernal Resistance
features.description: You have Resistance to Fire damage or Poison damage.

features.name: Infernal Sight
features.description: You gain Darkvision with a range of 30 feet. This Darkvision is unimpeded by magical Darkness.

features.name: Silver-Tongued
features.description: You gain proficiency in the Deception skill.
